parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with narrow QRS, normal axis and upright T waves, with no ST elevation reaching STEMI thresholds in any contiguous leads. The only ST elevation is about 1 mm, concave, after the deep S wave in V2, which is a normal variant, and there are no reciprocal changes or pathologic Q waves. This tracing does not show an acute STEMI, so it may be an early or baseline ECG, and serial ECGs and troponin would be needed.
